The project

Learning through research.

Working with research mentor Phan Minh Hien, PhD, I collaborated on a study applying deep learning to the optimization of slotted casing designs for a small gas turbine engine compressor. My contributions included research synthesis, model evaluation, and technical manuscript development.

Research title

Multi-Objective Optimization Using Deep Learning for Slotted Casing Design in a Small Gas Turbine Engine Compressor

Current scope

The research explores the challenge of balancing multiple engineering objectives while communicating model assumptions and results with technical precision.

Further details

Research role

Co-Author working with research mentor Phan Minh Hien, PhD.

Individual contribution

Contributed to research synthesis, model evaluation, and technical manuscript development for the deep-learning-based multi-objective optimization study.
